title: Epochal experiments ops journal — risk scoring and rollback templates
content:
Purpose and intent:
This is an operational notebook for running short-lived, high-signal experiments we call "epochs". An epoch is a timeboxed cross-functional rollout designed to test a single mounted change (model variant, routing policy, quantization profile, caching tweak). The goal here is to capture play-by-play decisions, risk assessment, and a reproducible rollback template for fast reversion if observed risk exceeds thresholds.

High-level principles (working):
- Keep cohort sizes intentionally small for first epoch; prefer multiple staggered micro-epochs over one sweeping exposure.
- Attach a numeric risk score to each epoch before activation and re-evaluate live.
- Make a rollback decision language explicit and automated where possible (API flags + alert hooks).
- Prioritize user-visible quality metrics first, then infra signals.

Definitions (terms we use in this doc):
- Epoch: short experiment window (1–48 hours) with fixed cohort slices.
- Micro-cohort: 0.1%–2% of traffic from a targeted routing slice (region, account tier).
- Risk score: 0–100 composite calculated from quality, latency, error, and business signal deltas.
- Cumulative regret budget: allocated tolerance for negative delta before hard rollback.

Pre-activation checklist (must pass all soft gates):
- Ownership: Eng lead and Product owner confirmed in PR and rollout form.
- Tickets & artifacts: PR linked, smoke tests green (link), canary infra configured (flag + experiment id).
- Reference eval: static prompt set and automated oracle scoring for output quality (baseline stored).
- Monitoring hooks: dashboards created (P50/P95 latency, 5xx rate, cost-per-token, eval drift), alert thresholds wired.
- Communication: announcement posted to #rollouts-ops with experiment id, slices, and rollback window.

Risk scoring (proposed quick method):
Inputs: 
- Delta_quality (0–40): negative quality delta vs baseline on secret eval prompts weighted by severity.
- Delta_latency (0–20): increase in P95 relative to SLO bucketed by percentage.
- Delta_errors (0–20): spike in 5xx or client-visible failures.
- Delta_business (0–20): conversion/engagement sensitivity (business estimate provided by product).
Raw score = sum of inputs (higher means riskier). Map to action: 0–15 = monitor, 16–35 = pause & investigate, 36+ = immediate rollback.

Live run cadence (first 6 hours):
- 00:00: activate micro-cohort 0.5%
- 00:10: smoke-check (synthetic calls): ensure response shape and no 5xx
- 00:30: automated eval run on sampled responses vs baseline; quick human review of anomalous outputs
- 01:00: expand to 1% if score <= 12
- 03:00: expand to 3% if stable and business approval exists
Notes: expansion steps gated by a scoring snapshot and sign-off from product + eng SRE on-call.

Metrics to watch (priority order):
1) Quality: eval-set pass rate, hallucination count, safety-flag hits (per 10k requests)
2) Latency: P50 and P95 for the cohort compared to global baseline
3) Errors: 5xx rate and specific error classes (OOM, memdrop, RPC timeouts)
4) Cost: tokens generated per request and estimated per-minute cost delta for the cohort
5) Business sigs: conversion events, retention hooks (if applicable)

Rollback template (automation friendly):
- Trigger conditions (any one): risk_score >= 36 OR sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 15 minutes OR latency P95 > SLO * 1.8 for 10 minutes
- Immediate actions on trigger:
  1) Cut traffic to epoched variant to 0% via rollout controller (API call: /rollout/v1/revert?exp_id=EPOCH-xxx)
  2) Open incident with pre-filled template (title: "Auto-rollback EPOCH-xxx — triggered by {condition}") and tag on-call SRE + product manager
  3) Snapshot logs (request ids sampling), save a 10k-sample of model responses for forensic analysis
  4) If rollback fails, escalate to infra runbook (phone + PagerDuty)

Communication templates (short):
- Slack announcement (activation): "Activating EPOCH-{{id}}: model v2-quant, slice: US-std, start: {{time}}, initial cohort: 0.5%. Monitors: p95/5xx/quality-eval. Owner: Aisha Patel. If risk_score>=36 we will rollback automatically."
- Incident template (auto-rollback): "Auto-rollback EPOCH-{{id}} at {{time}} due to {{trigger}}. Effect: variant traffic cut to 0%. Actions taken: logs/samples captured, incident created, owner tagged. Next steps: forensic analysis and patch if needed."

Post-mortem / short retro (must include):
- Timestamped decision log (who signed off expansions, who acknowledged rollback)
- Key metrics pre/post and delta table
- Top 3 hypotheses for root cause
- Action items with owners and due dates (no more than 5)

Open questions / unresolved decisions (please annotate inline if you take ownership):
- How do we weight hallucination vs minor fluency regressions in Delta_quality? Proposal: hallucinations are 4x fluency misses but need product confirmation.
- Should cost signals (spike in tokens) be included in pre-activation risk score or only monitored post-activation? 
- Who has final expand authority at the 3% to 10% gates for revenue-impacting experiments? Suggest product + revenue PM sign-off.

Quick experiments log (epoch entries):
- EPOCH-2025-09-11-A: model v3-slim on US-std; activated 2025-09-11T08:00 -> expanded to 3% at 03:00 -> rolled back at 04:22 due to risk_score=42 (hallucination surge). Owner: Marco Sanchez. Post-mortem linked: CON-5421.
- EPOCH-2025-10-02-B: routing policy change to regional affinity; observed transient P95 bump, no rollback. Follow-up: caching improvements (Rahul).

Quick TODOs (short-term):
- [ ] Finalize numeric weights for Delta_quality (Aisha + Product)
- [ ] Add an automated indicator in Console that shows epoch risk score in header
- [ ] Add synthetic oracle tests to the activation pipeline (PR linked)

Notes to self: keep this doc as the lightweight ledger for small experiments. For larger A/B matrices (>5 variants or >14-day experiments) move to the longer-run experiments runbook (product/experiments). Also consider a separate "regret accounting" spreadsheet to tally cumulative negative delta across overlapping epochs.

References and links:
- Experiment API spec: PR#2781
- Rollout controller runbook: confluence/rollouts/ctrl-runbook

If you touch this doc, drop a one-line summary at the top with your initials and date so we have a quick provenance log.

-- Aisha P. (initial draft) 2025-10-09
